### Day 111: Mark 1:21–28
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-111-mark-1-2128.html
Passage: Mark 1:21-28
Points:
- Jesus' newly called disciples watched their local community react with astonishment to His authoritative teaching in the Capernaum synagogue.
- The demonic presence was unable to remain concealed once the divine authority of Jesus was released.
- Jesus exercised absolute command over the unclean spirit, ordering it to be silent and come out of the man.
- While human spectators are easily drawn to dramatic displays of power, Christ seeks to build deeper spiritual maturity in His followers.
